speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ischemic Cardiomyopathy with Prior Myocardial Infarction. The combination of exertional dyspnea, dry cough, and confirmed echo findings of reduced ejection fraction with apical and anterior wall hypokinesis indicates heart failure secondary to old heart attack damage.
